plugins.name: zcode-swarm
plugins.description: Team development for ZCode (v2.0): the main session orchestrates directly with the Agent tool — one requirement splits into non-overlapping task cards, background builders run in parallel with per-card independent review, rework, dynamic expansion and a verification gate; state in .swarm/ledger.json, progress on Gen UI cards plus a persistent side-panel team board (swarm_board). Nothing to launch: send /swarm <requirement>. Models are decided by ZCode Settings → Subagents (ZCode Swarm); the plugin does not configure models.
